title: Influence bound for linear threshold functions
statement: Let $r$ be a positive integer and let $f:\\{-1,1\\}^r\\to\\{-1,1\\}$ be a linear threshold function: there are real weights $a_1,\\ldots,a_r$ and a real threshold offset $a_0$ such that $f(x)$ is the sign of $a_0+\\sum_{i=1}^r a_i x_i$, with a nonnegative input sent to $1$ and a negative input sent to $-1$. Then the total influence of $f$ is at most $\\sqrt{r}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on $r$ signs
$f$ is represented by a real affine threshold
